notes: Integration test (right): K5 dossier coordinates → façade generator v2 (granite piers 2.70 m on the tower, ceramic bands on the wing) → full 3D context (survey terrain, river, bridge with helmets, autumn trees) → Cycles render in ~30 s at preview resolution.

First read of the massing: the tower stands back from the bridge portal, the wing closes the Mazowiecka frontage to No. 19, and the garden court opens south — consistent with the heritage brief ('rebuild the block, not the tenements').

Known issues to be resolved by the synthesis: the 12 m Sejmik storey (driven by the 35 m minimum roof height in zone A at only P+5) vs. an extra office floor (+1,146 m², ≈ +5 M PLN); presidium orientation; technical platform; façade language (vertical rhythm & lamellas).
Board design system ready (1000 × 700 mm, 12-column grid, Inter typography, terracotta accent, numbered header, anonymous).
Next steps once the spec lands: parametric model → floor plans 1:200 with room numbers/areas → sections/elevations → photoreal renders (incl. F.17 montages) → boards.
